description.content:
The new [Company Master Data Enrich](#8b6cffe4-cb34-44ab-ad5d-1953d372ffd3) endpoint brings together ZoomInfo firmographic data with the EverString firmographic data along with significant improvements including additional firmographic attributes and enhanced data.

Refer to the examples provided to build a valid JSON request. For supported input and output parameters:

*   Use the [Company Master Enrich Inputs](#d305402c-33d1-488c-8b8f-b5b079868a61) endpoint to retrieve a list of valid input parameters you can provide
*   Use the [Company Master Enrich Outputs](#58b47522-753a-4104-a0c6-454adf4b6a1d) endpoint to retrieve a list of valid output fields that can be returned

Use this endpoint to match company information based on [input values](#d305402c-33d1-488c-8b8f-b5b079868a61) and return the desired [output fields](#58b47522-753a-4104-a0c6-454adf4b6a1d) in the response.

**Maximum inputs per request**

You can input a maximum of 25 companies in a single enrich request, returning the equivalent number of matching records. See the endpoint examples for how to build queries using multiple inputs.

**Declaring desired output**

You must explicitly list the desired output fields in your request. For example, a simple request might look like this:

```
{
    "matchCompanyInput": [
        {
            "address": {
                "zi_c_street": "805 Broadway St",
                "zi_c_state": "Washington",
                "zi_c_city": "Vancouver",
                "zi_c_zip": "98660",
                "zi_c_country": "United States"
            },
            "phone": {
                "zi_c_phone": "+1 3607836800",
                "zi_c_country": "United States"
            },
            "zi_c_location_id": 2079041960,
            "zi_c_url": "zoomInfo.com",
            "zi_c_name": "zoomInfo"
        }
    ],
    "outputFields": [
        "zi_c_location_id",
        "zi_es_ecid",
        "zi_es_location_id",
        "zi_c_is_hq",
        "zi_c_tier_grade",
        "zi_c_name",
        "zi_c_name_display",
        "zi_c_legal_entity_type",
        "zi_c_url",
        "zi_c_street",
        "zi_c_street_2",
        "zi_c_city",
        "zi_c_state",
        "zi_c_zip",
        "zi_c_country"
   ]
}

 ```

To keep the response data clean and unambiguous, if there is no data for a requested field, or it is NULL/EMPTY, the API will not return the field in the response.

**Response status codes and error handling**

This endpoint supports up to 25 inputs per request and will return a HTTP status code in the response indicating a 200, 400 or 5xx status.

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Request inputs are acceptable. The API can return a successful match or no match. |
| 400 | Indicates an error in the request input. |
| 5xx | Indicates a server-side error. Retry the request or contact ZoomInfo Support if the issue persists. |

When a request includes multiple companies, the following will occur:

- If at least 1 input succeeds in a request containing multiple inputs (up to the limit of 25), a 200 HTTP status code will be returned.
- If none of the inputs succeed and the request includes only a combination of bad inputs and internal errors, the API will return a 400 HTTP status code.
- If all inputs fail due to a server-side error, the response body of all of the input will return a status code of 500.
    

**Input params**

See the examples for how to structure your request. You must explicitly list the desired output fields in your request. See the examples included with this endpoint for how to structure a request.

| Parameter | DataType | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| zi_c_location_id | Long integer or string | Unique ZoomInfo identifier for a company |
| zi_es_ecid | Long integer | Unique EverString identifier for a company |
| zi_c_company_id | String | Unique ZoomInfo identifier for a company HQ location (parent) |
| zi_es_location_id | String | Unique EverString location id of a company |
| zi_c_url | String | Website of the company to enrich |
| zi_c_name | String | Name of the company to enrich |
| phone | Object | Phone number of a company. The input format is {zi_c_country: United States, zi_c_phone: xxxxxxx}. If "zi_c_phone" already has a country code, you do not need to input "zi_c_country". |
| address | Object | Address of the company to enrich. Input format is {zi_c_street: xxxxxxx, zi_c_city: xxxxxxx, zi_c_state: xxxxxxx, zi_c_zip: xxxxxxx, zi_c_country: xxxxxxx} |
| email | String | An email of a contact from the company |
| match_reasons | ArrayList | Minimum Match criteria to enrich the company. Accepts an array of objects. Optional customized match reasons specified on different attributes and match_score to decide how the match for that particular attribute should be. Acceptable attributes: zi_c_name, zi_c_url, bldg_name, bldg_number, road_name, road_type, directional, unit, zi_c_city, zi_c_state, zi_c_zip, zi_c_country, zi_c_phone, biz_type and match_score. Acceptable values for attributes: E (exact match), F (fuzzy match), D (different match) and M (missing). Input format is \[{ zi_c_name: F, zi_c_url: E, zi_c_state: E, match_score: 3 }, { zi_c_name: E, zi_c_phone: E, match_score: 3 }\] |
